title: Speaking: Action & Reporting Verbs
sub: Strong verbs that news reports and confident speakers rely on.

cards.def:
To make something known publicly.
हिंदी: घोषणा करना
examples: Present: Officials announce results at noon.
Past: The firm announced a merger.
Future: She will announce her decision.
Perfect: They have announced the dates.

cards.def:
To state something firmly and officially.
हिंदी: घोषित करना
examples: Past: The state declared an emergency.
Future: He will declare his support.

cards.def:
To say something is true without proof.
हिंदी: दावा करना
examples: Past: He claimed he was innocent.
Future: She will claim the prize.

cards.def:
To demand firmly.
हिंदी: ज़ोर देना
examples: Future: They will insist on a guarantee.
Perfect: I have insisted many times.

cards.def:
To state confidently.
हिंदी: दृढ़ता से कहना
examples: Present: Experts assert that exercise helps.
Future: She will assert her rights.
Perfect: They have asserted their authority.

cards.def:
To give reasons or quarrel.
हिंदी: तर्क देना / बहस करना
examples: Future: He will argue against the plan.
Perfect: She has argued for reform.

cards.def:
To put forward an idea.
हिंदी: सुझाव देना
examples: Past: She suggested a new route.
Future: He will suggest a solution.
Perfect: They have suggested a delay.

cards.def:
To advise as a good choice.
हिंदी: सिफ़ारिश करना
examples: Future: He will recommend a dentist.

cards.def:
To tell of possible danger.
हिंदी: चेतावनी देना
examples: Present: Signs warn drivers of curves.
Future: She will warn them tomorrow.
Perfect: Doctors have warned about smoking.

cards.def:
To make known something hidden.
हिंदी: प्रकट करना
examples: Future: The report will reveal the truth.
Perfect: She has revealed her plans.

cards.def:
To state that something is true.
हिंदी: पुष्टि करना
examples: Future: They will confirm the details.
Perfect: She has confirmed her visit.

cards.def:
To say something is not true.
हिंदी: इनकार करना
examples: Future: She will deny any role.
Perfect: They have denied the claim.

cards.def:
To agree that something is true.
हिंदी: स्वीकार करना
examples: Future: She will admit the truth.

cards.def:
To accept that something exists or is true.
हिंदी: स्वीकार करना / मानना
examples: Future: The firm will acknowledge the mistake.

cards.def:
To give special importance.
हिंदी: ज़ोर देना

To draw attention to.
हिंदी: उजागर करना
examples: Future: The speech will highlight reforms.
Perfect: She has highlighted the risks.

cards.def:
To describe the main points.
हिंदी: रूपरेखा बताना
examples: Future: She will outline the schedule.
Perfect: They have outlined the budget.

cards.def:
To explain in more detail.
हिंदी: विस्तार से बताना
examples: Present: Please elaborate on your idea.
Past: He elaborated on the plan.
Perfect: They have elaborated their view.

cards.def:
To make something clearer.
हिंदी: स्पष्ट करना
examples: Future: He will clarify the position.
Perfect: They have clarified the facts.

cards.def:
To convince someone to do something.
हिंदी: मनाना
examples: Past: She persuaded him to stay.
Future: He will persuade the board.

cards.def:
To make someone believe.
हिंदी: विश्वास दिलाना

To give support and confidence.
हिंदी: प्रोत्साहित करना
examples: Past: She encouraged him to apply.
Future: He will encourage the team.

cards.def:
To reduce someone's confidence.
हिंदी: हतोत्साहित करना
examples: Future: High fees will discourage students.

cards.def:
To fill with the desire to do something.
हिंदी: प्रेरित करना
examples: Past: Her speech inspired the crowd.
Future: His story will inspire students.

cards.def:
To give a reason to act.
हिंदी: प्रेरित करना
examples: Past: The coach motivated the team.
Perfect: He has motivated the staff.

cards.def:
To succeed in dealing with a problem.
हिंदी: पार पाना
examples: Present: People overcome fear with practice.
Future: He will overcome the obstacle.
Perfect: They have overcome many hurdles.

cards.def:
To succeed in reaching a goal.
हिंदी: हासिल करना
examples: Future: He will achieve his dream.
Perfect: They have achieved their targets.

cards.def:
To complete successfully.
हिंदी: पूरा करना
examples: Future: She will accomplish her goals.

cards.def:
To try to do something.
हिंदी: प्रयास करना
examples: Past: He attempted a record jump.
Future: She will attempt the exam again.
Perfect: They have attempted a rescue.

cards.def:
To follow in order to achieve.
हिंदी: पीछा करना / अपनाना
examples: Past: She pursued a career in law.
Future: He will pursue higher studies.
Perfect: They have pursued the matter.

cards.def:
To try very hard.
हिंदी: भरसक प्रयास करना
examples: Future: She will strive for perfection.
Perfect: They have striven for years.

cards.def:
To try hard against difficulty.
हिंदी: संघर्ष करना
examples: Present: Many students struggle with maths.
Future: She will struggle at first.
Perfect: They have struggled for years.

cards.def:
To continue firmly despite difficulty.
हिंदी: डटे रहना
examples: Future: She will persist until it works.
Perfect: They have persisted for years.

cards.def:
To pause before acting.
हिंदी: हिचकिचाना
examples: Future: She will hesitate to sign.
Perfect: They have hesitated too long.

cards.def:
To refuse to accept or give in to.
हिंदी: विरोध करना / रोकना
examples: Perfect: They have resisted the plan.

cards.def:
To give up to an opponent.
हिंदी: आत्मसमर्पण करना
examples: Future: He will surrender to the police.
Perfect: They have surrendered their weapons.

cards.def:
To leave completely.
हिंदी: त्याग देना
examples: Future: He will abandon the plan.
Perfect: She has abandoned the project.

cards.def:
To fail to care for.
हिंदी: उपेक्षा करना
examples: Perfect: They have neglected the garden.

cards.def:
To pay no attention.
हिंदी: अनदेखा करना
examples: Future: She will ignore the rumours.
Perfect: They have ignored the advice.

cards.def:
To watch carefully.
हिंदी: ध्यान से देखना
examples: Future: He will observe the class.

cards.def:
To inspect closely.
हिंदी: जाँचना
examples: Future: She will examine the contract.
Perfect: They have examined the data.

cards.def:
To study in detail.
हिंदी: विश्लेषण करना
examples: Future: He will analyse the report.
Perfect: They have analysed the cause.

cards.def:
To judge the value or quality of.
हिंदी: मूल्यांकन करना
examples: Future: She will evaluate the plan.
Perfect: They have evaluated each bid.

cards.def:
To estimate the nature or quality.
हिंदी: आकलन करना
examples: Future: He will assess the situation.
Perfect: They have assessed the risk.

cards.def:
To roughly calculate.
हिंदी: अनुमान लगाना
examples: Future: She will estimate the time.
Perfect: They have estimated the damage.

cards.def:
To say what will happen.
हिंदी: भविष्यवाणी करना
examples: Future: She will predict the trend.
Perfect: They have predicted a slowdown.

cards.def:
To expect and prepare for.
हिंदी: पूर्वानुमान लगाना

To suppose without proof.
हिंदी: मान लेना
examples: Perfect: They have assumed too much.

cards.def:
To suggest indirectly.
हिंदी: इशारा करना
examples: Past: She implied he was lying.
Future: The memo will imply a threat.
Perfect: He has implied a change.

cards.def:
To point to or show.
हिंदी: संकेत देना
examples: Past: The data indicated a trend.
Future: Results will indicate the cause.
Perfect: Studies have indicated a link.

cards.def:
To show clearly.
हिंदी: प्रदर्शित करना
examples: Future: He will demonstrate the skill.

cards.def:
To explain with examples.
हिंदी: उदाहरण देकर समझाना
examples: Future: She will illustrate the idea.
Perfect: They have illustrated the cost.

cards.def:
To give a short account.
हिंदी: सारांश देना
examples: Future: He will summarise the meeting.
Perfect: They have summarised the facts.

cards.def:
To refer briefly.
हिंदी: उल्लेख करना
examples: Future: She will mention the delay.
Perfect: They have mentioned it twice.

cards.def:
To tell what something is like.
हिंदी: वर्णन करना
examples: Future: He will describe the route.
Perfect: They have described the problem.

cards.def:
To tell a story.
हिंदी: कथन करना
examples: Future: She will narrate the story.
Perfect: They have narrated the history.

cards.def:
To discuss opposing views.
हिंदी: बहस करना
examples: Future: Leaders will debate on Monday.
Perfect: Experts have debated the issue.

cards.def:
To talk about something.
हिंदी: चर्चा करना
examples: Future: They will discuss the proposal.
Perfect: She has discussed it with him.

cards.def:
To work together.
हिंदी: सहयोग करना
examples: Past: They collaborated on a book.
Future: Firms will collaborate on research.
Perfect: She has collaborated with experts.

cards.def:
To organise so parts work together.
हिंदी: समन्वय करना
examples: Future: He will coordinate the rescue.

cards.def:
To give tasks to others.
हिंदी: काम सौंपना

To oversee people or work.
हिंदी: देखरेख करना
examples: Future: He will supervise the team.
Perfect: They have supervised the repair.

cards.def:
To put a plan into effect.
हिंदी: लागू करना
examples: Future: He will implement the change.
Perfect: The firm has implemented new rules.

cards.def:
To carry out a plan.
हिंदी: निष्पादित करना
examples: Past: He executed the plan perfectly.
Future: She will execute the order.
Perfect: They have executed the project.

cards.def:
To change slightly.
हिंदी: संशोधित करना
examples: Future: He will modify the code.
Perfect: They have modified the rules.

cards.def:
To adjust to new conditions.
हिंदी: ढलना / अनुकूलित करना
examples: Future: He will adapt to the change.

cards.def:
To change completely.
हिंदी: रूपांतरित करना
examples: Perfect: She has transformed the school.

cards.def:
To become or make larger.
हिंदी: विस्तार करना
examples: Past: The firm expanded last year.
Perfect: They have expanded the factory.

cards.def:
To make smaller or less.
हिंदी: घटाना
examples: Future: The state will reduce taxes.
Perfect: The firm has reduced waste.

cards.def:
To remove completely.
हिंदी: समाप्त करना
examples: Future: The law will eliminate loopholes.
Perfect: The state has eliminated polio.

cards.def:
To stop something from happening.
हिंदी: रोकना

To keep safe.
हिंदी: रक्षा करना
examples: Perfect: They have protected the forest.

cards.def:
To keep in good condition.
हिंदी: बनाए रखना
examples: Past: He maintained a steady pace.
Future: She will maintain the garden.

cards.def:
To keep from damage or decay.
हिंदी: सुरक्षित रखना
examples: Past: They preserved the old fort.
Future: We will preserve the forest.
Perfect: The museum has preserved records.

cards.def:
To bring back to a former state.
हिंदी: बहाल करना
examples: Perfect: She has restored her confidence.

cards.def:
To build again.
हिंदी: पुनर्निर्माण करना
examples: Future: The state will rebuild homes.
Perfect: He has rebuilt his business.

cards.def:
To return to a normal state.
हिंदी: ठीक होना / पुनः प्राप्त करना
examples: Past: She recovered from the flu.
Perfect: He has recovered his health.

cards.def:
To become worse.
हिंदी: बिगड़ना

To become or make better.
हिंदी: सुधारना
examples: Perfect: He has improved a lot.

cards.def:
To increase quality or value.
हिंदी: बढ़ाना / निखारना

To increase or improve.
हिंदी: बढ़ावा देना
examples: Future: Tax cuts will boost demand.
Perfect: The win has boosted morale.

cards.def:
To make stronger.
हिंदी: मज़बूत करना
examples: Future: Reforms will strengthen the economy.

cards.def:
To make less strong.
हिंदी: कमज़ोर करना
examples: Past: The storm weakened the bridge.
Perfect: Floods have weakened the dam.

cards.def:
To pose a danger.
हिंदी: धमकाना / ख़तरा पैदा करना
examples: Perfect: Rising seas have threatened coasts.

cards.def:
To cause something to begin.
हिंदी: भड़काना / शुरू करना
examples: Future: The news will trigger panic.
Perfect: A glitch has triggered the error.

cards.def:
To cause suddenly.
हिंदी: चिंगारी देना / भड़काना
examples: Future: The speech will spark debate.

cards.def:
To cause a strong reaction.
हिंदी: उकसाना
examples: Past: The remark provoked a fight.
Future: The move will provoke criticism.

cards.def:
To cause someone to act.
हिंदी: प्रेरित करना / उकसाना
examples: Past: The news prompted a response.
Perfect: The report has prompted action.

cards.def:
To give towards a shared goal.
हिंदी: योगदान देना
examples: Present: Everyone contributes to the project.

cards.def:
To take part.
हिंदी: भाग लेना
examples: Past: He participated in the debate.
Future: She will participate in the race.
Perfect: They have participated in surveys.

cards.def:
To be present at.
हिंदी: उपस्थित होना
examples: Future: She will attend the lecture.
Perfect: They have attended every class.

cards.def:
To delay until later.
हिंदी: स्थगित करना
examples: Future: She will postpone the meeting.
Perfect: The board has postponed the vote.

cards.def:
To call off.
हिंदी: रद्द करना
examples: Present: Airlines cancel flights in storms.
Future: He will cancel the order.
Perfect: She has cancelled her plans.

cards.def:
To begin again after a pause.
हिंदी: फिर से शुरू करना
examples: Perfect: Work has resumed on the road.

cards.def:
To take back or remove.
हिंदी: वापस लेना
examples: Present: People withdraw cash from ATMs.
Future: She will withdraw her support.
Perfect: They have withdrawn from the race.

cards.def:
To hand in for consideration.
हिंदी: जमा करना
examples: Future: He will submit the form.
Perfect: They have submitted their bids.

cards.def:
To officially accept.
हिंदी: मंज़ूरी देना
examples: Past: The council approved the plan.
Future: He will approve the request.
Perfect: They have approved the loan.

cards.def:
To refuse to accept.
हिंदी: अस्वीकार करना
examples: Past: The board rejected the offer.
Future: She will reject the idea.
Perfect: They have rejected the plan.

cards.def:
To give official permission.
हिंदी: अधिकृत करना
examples: Future: She will authorise the repair.
Perfect: They have authorised the visit.

cards.def:
To forbid by rule or law.
हिंदी: प्रतिबंधित करना
examples: Future: The city will prohibit plastic bags.
